odc_type: incorrect default reference date for partial date calculations
observation_summary: An IllegalFieldValueException is thrown when calculating the difference between partial dates that include February 29th.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the library uses a default reference date of 1970-01-01 (represented as 0L) when performing calculations on partial dates like 'MonthDay'. Since 1970 is not a leap year, any attempt to process February 29th results in an 'IllegalFieldValueException' because the day is out of bounds for that year. The fix changes the reference date from 0L (1970) to a leap year (1972), which allows February 29th to be valid during internal calculations.
